changed.title: On the one-a-side promise with AND/OR gates of fan-in exactly two, each edge in a nonfull row and column lights an AND whose operands split the two singletons
changed.statement:
∀ (n m : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
  PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (n + m) C →
  PEqualNP.Represents.Represents G C →
  ∀ (u : Fin n) (v : Fin m), G u v = true →
    (∃ c : Fin m, G u c = false) → (∃ r : Fin n, G r v = false) →
    let rowOnly := List.ofFn (fun r₀ : Fin n => decide (r₀ = u)) ++ List.replicate m false
    let colOnly := List.replicate n false ++ List.ofFn (fun c₀ : Fin m => decide (c₀ = v))
    let value := fun (x : List Bool) (w : ℕ) => (C.wires x).getD w false
    let split := fun (left right : ℕ) =>
      value rowOnly left = true ∧ value rowOnly right = false ∧
      value colOnly right = true ∧ value colOnly left = false
    ∃ (j : Fin C.gates.length) (a b : ℕ),
      (C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧
      (C.gates.get j).inputs = [a, b] ∧
      value (PEqualNP.Represents.oneEach u v) (n + m + j.val) = true ∧
      (split a b ∨ split b a)
changed.unlocks: the AND gate at which each edge comes to need both of its inputs in an AND/OR circuit on the one-a-side promise, a tool for the counts of that line; it moves no bound by itself
changed.context: On paper. Take three inputs: row u alone, column v alone, and the pair. The output is off on each single line, since a non-edge in that row or column would otherwise be on by monotonicity; it is on at the pair. Take the earliest wire that is on at the pair and off on both single lines. It is not an input. It is not an OR: an operand on at the pair is earlier, so a single line turns it on, and then the OR too. So it is an AND; both operands are on at the pair, each is turned on by a single line, and neither line turns on both. So the row alone lights one operand and the column alone the other.

changed.sketch: A search unit. We hold a circuit of 10 AND/OR gates (three plain forms, full lines taken out, equal gates merged and unread gates dropped); at this size those forms are weak; we hold none of 9; this is a search.
